services.name: 22' Pontoon
services.desc: Our pontoon rentals are an ideal option for those seeking a laid-back and peaceful way to explore the breathtaking waters of Okanagan Lake. These spacious and comfortable boats have a capacity of 12 people, making them perfect for family outings, social gatherings, or even a day of fishing. Equipped with all the necessary amenities, our well-maintained pontoons provide a living room atmosphere on the water, allowing you to relax and enjoy the picturesque surroundings. Come and experience an unforgettable pontoon adventure in the heart of the Okanagan Valley with your loved ones! Please note: all prices are exclusive of taxes and fuel costs.Our 22′ or 27′ Pontoon is a Harris or South Bay

includes: Safety instructions on proper boat operation

blurb: Guests can choose from a variety of watercraft including personal watercraft, powerboats, pontoons, and stand up paddleboards for aquatic adventures on the lake. Rentals have minimum durations in July and August and fuel and taxes are not included in the rental price. The company provides safety instructions and guidance on local destinations.
extraNote: Fuel and taxes not included in rental price · Sea Doos have a 2-hour minimum rental in July and August · Motorized vessels have a 4-hour minimum rental in July and August
